prompt.task_description: Analyze ERIE's financial performance change between the quarter ending 2016-12-31 and the quarter ending 2017-03-31. Revenue increased by $19,703,000. Decompose this change into its key drivers: identify which product/business segments and geographic regions contributed most to the revenue change, and identify the main margin drivers (changes in gross margin, operating expenses as a percentage of revenue). Use only data available as of 2017-05-01.
prompt.output_instructions: Respond with a JSON object containing: revenue_delta (int, USD), top_revenue_drivers (array of objects with driver, type, direction, magnitude_usd, contribution_pct), and margin_drivers (array of objects with driver, type, direction, delta_pp).
